experiences.summary: Led a team of 5 engineers building SOBERANA, a multi-tenant cross-border payments platform, and moved its infrastructure from AWS to Azure.
description: Led a team of 5 engineers on SOBERANA, a multi-tenant cross-border treasury and payments platform for fintech companies: custodial wallets, virtual accounts by country and payment rail, deposits and withdrawals. I set the team's engineering standards: mandatory pull-request review, an INVEST-based backlog, and Playwright end-to-end tests.

Closed 12 findings from a security audit carried out with a partner firm using OpenAI's Daybreak: idempotency of money-moving operations, SSRF protection, API key lifecycle, and encryption of stored secrets.
Led the AWS-to-Azure migration with the CTO, rebuilding the infrastructure in Terraform: Container Apps, Static Web Apps, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Key Vault, and managed identities.

Built CI/CD on GitHub Actions with OIDC (no stored cloud credentials), ephemeral environments per pull request, and releases by version tag, backed by 6,000+ automated tests. Cut deployment time by 60% (from 15 to 6 minutes) on the AWS pipeline through Terraform automation.
Integrated external providers for custody, virtual accounts, payouts, and KYC behind Strategy and Adapter patterns, so adding a provider does not change the core.

Built LoopayOCR, a compliance document management system using Google Gemini OCR for cross-border financial transactions, with dynamic Pydantic schema validation, S3 storage, and webhook notifications.

experiences.summary: Motorcycle e-commerce with embedded financing. Built NestJS services, a backend-for-frontend layer, and Next.js interfaces for the Checkout and Risk teams.
description: Worked on the Checkout and Risk teams building NestJS backend services, a backend-for-frontend (BFF) layer, and Next.js interfaces on event-driven microservices in AWS.
Maintained systems on the critical path of checkout and risk evaluation, with incidents handled through PagerDuty.
Managed cloud infrastructure, observability, and deployment pipelines using Terraform, Datadog, GitHub Actions, and AWS.

experiences.summary: Co-founded a startup for residential communities and took its mobile app from MVP to production in about a month.
description: Co-founded a startup and took a digital-intercom mobile app from MVP to production in about a month, working in a remote team of 7 across Colombia, Mexico, and Venezuela.
Built the mobile app and backend with React Native, Laravel, WebRTC with a TURN server, and WebSockets, and kept releasing until a pilot with a test community.
Operated the infrastructure and, when funding ran out, moved it from AWS to DigitalOcean, migrating the database ahead of the DNS cutover with no data loss.

experiences.summary: Full-stack development of the main platform with RedwoodJS, GraphQL, and Prisma.
description: Full-stack development of the main platform on RedwoodJS: interactive React UI and server-side Node.js logic.
Optimized data access via GraphQL and Prisma ORM.
CI/CD setup and maintenance with GitHub Actions for automated deployment and integration workflows.

experiences.summary: Built an Angular single-page app on Node.js microservices, with Algolia search and Zoom video conferencing.
description: Microservices architecture: Angular SPA frontend with highly modular backend services using Express / Node.js and MongoDB.
Complex API integrations: Algolia indexed search engine and embedded Zoom SDK video conferencing.

experiences.summary: Self-taught. Built and launched e-commerce stores with WooCommerce and PrestaShop.
description: Self-taught. Built and launched e-commerce stores with WooCommerce and PrestaShop, and a static site in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
